run: 3-split held-out K562, Colab GPU (device=cuda), user-run of the committed transformer_ko4.py
verdict: TRANSFORMER v4 (transformer_ko4.py), 3-split Colab GPU run: v3-full base 0.487+/-0.025 vs best spatial (+spatial-bias) 0.495+/-0.017 = +0.007, NOT stable across splits (per-split -0.014/+0.017/+0.018; +spatial-mask is even slightly negative). Spatial gating (GO compartment) is a WASH, exactly as predicted: compartment is already latent in the network-SVD (an SVD of the same complex/PPI graph that respects compartments), and the gap to the 0.614 oracle is DATA/READOUT-limited (cross_line: specific far-field ~85% context-specific), not localisation-limited. Identity shuffle collapses to 0.108. CONFIRMS the session thesis across every architectural lever tried (v2 objective upgrades wash, v3 edge-bias, v4 spatial wash): features help the model ROUTE within the reproducible signal but do not break ~0.62; breaking it needs transient (2-12h) kinetics data, unavailable here. The best deployable model stays the interaction-context transformer at ~0.49 (63% of tide->oracle head-room), whose gain came from the REAL interaction structure (v3 real-vs-random +0.335), not from objective/spatial add-ons.
